name: Simmered in salsa verde
intro: A pot of salsa verde and something simmered in it until the sauce thickens. Chicken thighs on Sunday, eggs on Wednesday.
yield: Chicken: dinner and three lunches. Eggs: dinner for one.

proteins.name: Boneless chicken thighs
proteins.timing: Simmered covered in the salsa, about 25 minutes, then shredded in the sauce.

proteins.name: Eggs
proteins.timing: No meat. Cracked into hollows in the simmering sauce, covered 4–5 minutes.

needs: Salsa verde, a full batch: 1 lb tomatillos, 1 roasted chile, a handful of cilantro, juice of 1 lime, salt

steps.text: No salsa verde yet? Boil the husked tomatillos 5 minutes until olive-green, then blend with the chile, cilantro, lime, and salt.
Bring the salsa verde to a simmer in a wide pan with a lid.
Chicken: add the salted thighs, cover, and simmer gently until they shred easily. Shred them right in the sauce.
Eggs: make four hollows in the sauce, crack an egg into each, and cover until the whites set.

leftovers: The chicken keeps four days in its sauce. It's tacos and rice bowls all week.
